title: Power iteration for the top eigenpair
summary: The top eigenvalue and eigenvector of a symmetric matrix by power iteration, with a tolerance, an iteration limit and a sign rule.

mutants.argmax_without_abs: Uses np.argmax(v) in the sign rule, so it ignores a large negative entry.
mutants.eigenvalue_from_norm: Returns the norm of M v as the eigenvalue, so a negative eigenvalue becomes positive.
mutants.no_sign_fix: Returns the final vector without the sign rule.
mutants.signed_convergence: Tests the dot product without the absolute value, so a negative top eigenvalue never stops early.
mutants.v0_not_normalized: Does not divide v0 by its norm, so the first stop test is wrong for a long start vector.
